# Repository Agent Skills

This repo consumes the TrafficMesh skill policy from TrafficMesh/civicmesh-docs, pinned by .trafficmesh/agent-skills.yaml. The docs repository is the common source and registry; upstream Matt Pocock skill text is vendored there at revision 3fc5632f401156837ee3872f14fe33ccf1024ea.

Skills listed as enabled are task guidance. The manifest marks other skills as gated or prohibited. No skill grants permission to publish issues, merge, deploy, or affect production. Read the repository's existing contracts, README, and security/privacy guidance first; those sources remain authoritative over generic skill advice.

See .trafficmesh/agent-skills.yaml for this repo's enabled skill set and scope.

The three `trafficmesh-*` native skills are adapted from [PSDC Agent Skills](https://github.com/Post-Secondary-Digital-Commons/psdc-agent-skills) at revision `55808788e8a896b8dca2f492fddac9e3aa091c15` under Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE-PSDC-Native`; their wording has been adapted for TrafficMesh.
